items.criterion: A packed tarball (npm pack) installed into an empty project via npm install <tgz> exits 0 with no postinstall failure; npm run lint stays green; a regression test asserts every repo-relative script referenced by package.json postinstall is present in the published tarball or postinstall is removed.
items.detail: npm pack --pack-destination /tmp/ux001 --offline produced speclang-1.0.0.tgz (1748 files); `tar tzf` lists package/scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh, so the script referenced by package.json postinstall ships in the tarball. Fresh empty project /tmp/ux001-fresh2: `npm install /tmp/ux001/speclang-1.0.0.tgz --offline --foreground-scripts` -> INSTALL_EXIT=0, log shows "> speclang@1.0.0 postinstall / > bash scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh / TS 6 alias not found, skipping postinstall" and "added 151 packages ... found 0 vulnerabilities"; plain `npm install <tgz>` also exit 0. `npm run lint` -> LINT_EXIT=0, "3 problems (0 errors, 3 warnings)". Regression test tests/cli/pack-contract.test.ts run via `npx vitest run tests/cli/pack-contract.test.ts` -> Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 3 passed (3), exit 0; it parses scripts.postinstall, resolves each repo-relative script path, compares against the `npm pack --dry-run --json` file list and asserts the missing set is empty (early-returns if postinstall was removed). Installed CLI smoke check: `node node_modules/speclang/bin/speclang --version` -> 1.0.0, exit 0. [resolution 0.04; package.json]

summary: The published tarball now contains scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh, a fresh install of the packed tarball exits 0 with a clean postinstall, lint stays green, and a new pack-contract regression test guards the postinstall-script/tarball invariant.
